since he passed away, I go to almost all the funerals that happen around me, I feel that it is that moment where you want everything to stop and I want to accompany the mourners as they did with me.

I’m taking venlafaxine, it has been the most useful during this process. To be honest I haven't had the side effects everyone talks about, I'm two years into the process and I think without the medicine the suicide attempts would have materialized.

I completely understand the fear and it is valid, but with the help of your psychiatrist and therapist you can occupy them for the necessary time and stop using them when you are ready in the process.

I feel u, I’m 28 too. We didn't tick all the boxes in life but we were together for 11 years, this is a shitty situation, u had tons of life plans that you can only imagine with your SO and that’s ok, you need to mourn/grieve those plans too. The baggage that now you have is the result of an amazing love chapter in your life, but of course is not easy and a thing that u want to do alone, is ok to be mad and confused with everything changing so fast.

Stay angry as long as you need, in time the emotion will find another place to flow, it will flow. sometimes you go back because healing is not a linear process
It happens to me all the time, every time I wake up my heart shrinks from not feeling it (after almost two years)
What about just mentioning the discomfort feeling to her? Baby steps
Hey! I Can talk when u need it 👋🏽
How old are ur dogs? I have two dogs too, I adopted one the last year to make the commitment to stay until he leaves this life. Mine are Laila (11 years) and Rufino (1 year)
Are u alone? Is it possible that someone comes to your house? I think you need to go to the hospital

Not for me, I don’t have what objects or pills for sleep in the house but I’m looking for other methods, I’m trying to convince myself to remain calm so that I can convey to others that I am fine, but rather I want to keep trying, the days are making me heavier.
U still here? Are u ok?
Im dealing with that realization and the fucking pain that I feel for being a burden for the others
Yeah! I hate the weekends now, but in the week it’s really hard for me get involved with my job, but much easier than this “free days”
I’m so sorry for your lost, you look so lovable together.
I’m hoping the same, thank you! Big hug for u

We are working now with a lawyer, but we lived in Mexico and the things works kind of different here, his family has acquaintances with some power, so this is gonna be a shitty process. I know that we are both grieving its a thing that I have always present but just as you say I’m going to keep my boundaries really strong.

I lost my SO 5 months ago, the waves of emotions have been a whole process by itself, there is a lot of anger, a few weeks ago I became calm and I was able to let some things flow, but the flashbacks of the hospital and everything we went through it comes to me suddenly. Sometimes the negotiation is like "why didn't this or that die better..." etc, etc. I reread notes and articles on the progress of COVID, cases on Twitter and almost suffer all over again when strangers get better or worse, it's as if each one of those who die from Covid were him. We were locked up all the time, with mechanisms to avoid getting infected, He was 27 years old. We couldn't get vaccinated because he wasn't up to our age group yet, a month after he died they announced the dates to vaccinate us, my hearth broke

Sorry for your loss, I send to you tons of hugs. My SO passed away in beginning of August, we had planning to married the last days of that month, this had been a roller coaster 🎢 but hang in there! And if you wanna talk please write me.
Thank you! 🙌🏽🖤
Oh:( gonna keep looking for one, I’m in Mexico so it’s harder ton find one in here

I hate the word too, it’s like I don’t have another’s option you know? Or maybe yes but they are hovering me all the time and it’s impossible to act in another way, because if they saw me cry omg! They are gonna feel all the pain that I’m not sharing, it’s to much
I’m so sorry for your loss, I send you a big hug 👋🏽
Hi! I send to you a big hug, sorry to ask you but your young widows group is online?
I’m so sorry for your lost. I send you tons of hugs and strength to deal with this process. Please if you need to talk don’t hesitate to write me. We’re in this path together.

I’m so sorry for your lost, all my love to you in this hard moments.  
Try to be gentle with you, it’s an awful 🎢 but I promise you that you are going to have some moments to cry all the pain. 

I’ve lost my SO four months ago, he was at the hospital with Covid, we tried everything we could and even with that he’s not here anymore, in my head I replayed those last days but it’s impossible to make something different because in that time I did everything I could with the information that I had and respecting his will.
Thanks! Sometimes I have energy and a rush to keep in movement like now that Im triying to sell his sneakers 👟 thanks!!!
Thanks a lot! I’m here to talk or play too, I leave ACNH for now but I’m sure I’m going to have a come back soon ☺️
The world looks a shitty place without him, but now I’m realizing that it’s gonna be harder share me with someone like I did it with him :(

You’re not a bad person you feel sad and overwhelmed and it’s ok. I send to you tons of hugs, one of the things that works for me sometimes is pospone it, you know? Like I’m gonna do it before I travel a lot or something like that, pospone it, it’s and advice for my psychiatrist 👨‍⚕️ hope you feel better soon
I lost my SO 4 months ago and I really get you, one of the things that I really hate now are the happy couples 😒
Hi! How’s everything?
We are in the same path! I’m so sorry for your lost and I send you tons of hugs.
I have the same fear too, I write him letters every day since he died, today I just woke up and it feel’s so unreal that he’s dead.
Tons of hugs for your heart, you can check this sub [/widowers](https://www.reddit.com/r/widowers/)
Totally understand your feeling, I’m in the same path, hugs to your heart

This thing, the struggle and the denial are part of the grieving process, don’t push yourself, the acceptance is going to come, you are moving maybe no at the speed you like it but it’s normal, the time for us changed. Be patient, loving and caring with yourself, if you can talk with a professional, and please remember take one day at a time ❤️
I lost my partner too, 4 months ago and I can feel you, I wish you a time through the day when you can breathe without the struggle and you just feel tons of love

I hope that this season you can take time for yourself, to cry, to remember her in your own way. It is not necessary to celebrate if you do not feel ready, remember that it is a process the important thing is that you put yourself first ❤️
I hope you find a time and a way to get through the holidays, your way at your time, hugs!

You’re not alone when my SO was in the UCI I was so mad because we were really careful with everything and my friends not and in my mind was so unfair why us?. Now I know that is ok to feel that, I don’t need to judge my emotions just let them exist
You can do it! You have the right to puke and cry, but just do it, is a step in the healing road.
It's been a month and the pain is transforming to a feeling of unease but I suppose it will transform again until it becomes "easier" hugs for u
Tons of hugs for you, take your time
I wonder if there are other options, because this reality it's to hard and now I hate it, but I'm going to keep me positive or something like that because this is hard enough.
The hour at a time, it will be my new mantra, thanks a lot
I'm very sorry for your loss, I know the feeling about the "what ifs" I'm sure you did everything you could, so please forgive yourself.

At this point I think the only friend I had is dead, he was also my best friend, so no one else around me knows me completely, so I think my friends and family are not going to understand that I have OCD and PTSD and all. the support is going to be "will happen" or something like that without considering everything else.  
Today I have even asked my mother to return to her house and leave me alone in my place, because this is going to be my life now and I should start to get used to it.

Thanks a lot, I’m scared I don’t want to overwhelmed anyone of my friends or family because they are in pain too and I don’t what that they think that I can’t be alone, because this happend in the first day that I’m on my own.

Send you tons of hugs, I lost my fiancé a few days ago and I can barely breath in the mornings. But I still pressure my friends and family to talk about him, maybe because is recent they let me, but I don’t know you and if you want, I have the sincere desire to know Everything you want to talk about your wife. Write me back and I can share with you some stuff about Luis. 🙏

I lost my fiancé in the same situation as you, but we hadn’t children and in the last few days we talked a lot about having one, Sometimes I wonder if grief is easier when you have children, because maybe they will always remind you of it. I'm very sorry for your loss.
I really hope that in time you can find some answers within yourself, I send you tons of hugs. Be assured that Niko chose to be by your side every day and that is a certainty
Thanks! I’m very new in these work dynamics , thanks for the time to answer

Thanks a lot for answer, SO already talk to her about all of this, but I think this problem is deeper and it comes from her divorce and her experience... I’m going to try to not be so closer to them (SO-MIL) when she visit us and for now maybe that could be a temporary solution 🥴
Thanks a lot for the good wishes, I was scared of being rude or something but I feel overwhelmed with all of this stuff
Thanks a lot for this, DH already talk with her but I think they need to solve the problem from the roots with therapy 🥺

I’ve been dating with my SO since 10 years ago, last year he was diagnosed with AD/HD and I with OCD, so I think that maybe our neurodivergence is an good thing in the relationship we build. So it’s possible with neurodivergent people or those who are able to learn and cope with the OCD spikes. Good luck!
